answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network maps identities into an interactive trust atlas where clusters undergo topological cut verifications. When suspicious nodes partition the graph, a game-theoretic multi-agent auditing mechanism activates. If auditing agents expose fabricated subgraphs, the coordinator executes stake slashing, seizing pledged capital like a burnt relic and imposing superlinear attacker cost. Honest validators are compensated with saffron staking yields.
